Although memory costs are projected to easily become the most expensive part of the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the situation with the iPhone Duo could be quite different. Here are the details.

Apple signs three-year exclusive deal with Samsung Display

In a new post on Weibo today, leaker Instant Digital claims that Apple and Samsung Display have signed a three-year exclusive supply agreement for foldable panels.

According to the leaker, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and subsequent models," with each panel costing around $250.

The leaker also noted that, unsurprisingly, this panel is "one of the most expensive core components" of the device.

Although there are no reliable reports yet disclosing the expected bill of materials costs for the iPhone Duo, after breaking down the cost structure of the display, camera, processor, memory, and other components, Apple has shared some interesting information about the materials used in the device, including how much recycled content is included.
